program: V3.1 Runtime Reliability, Loop Recovery & Jev MCP (Phases 21-42)

legend.done-kernel-side: codigo + suite verde + Reviewer/Security APPROVED no kernel ou plugin. NAO implica ativacao de flag nem prova no binario real do operador.
legend.done-invariant: propriedade estrutural verificada e mantida no registry/suites; nada depende de ambiente do operador.
legend.activation-pending: componente entregue e invocavel, mas registro/ativacao depende do estado ativo do operador (hooks, AGENTS.md global, default_agent, flags).
legend.blocked-operator-evidence: o criterio so se fecha com evidencia que o ambiente do operador produz (binario exato 2.0.18, lane Windows real, deploy VPS). SEM fake-close.
legend.gap: string vazia quando o criterio esta fechado; caso contrario, a pendencia restante, honesta e nomeada.

criteria.criterion: a hung worker cannot block its parent indefinitely.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase26.json#acceptance.hung_interrupt (backdated wall com filho real => HARD_TIMEOUT interrupt sob deadline externo real; WATCHDOG_INTERRUPTED + WATCHDOG_SETTLED na telemetria enforce-source)
criteria.gap: Semantic de interrupt PRESENTE e testada no kernel, mas: (1) flag watchdog permanece {enabled:false, shadow:true} - ativacao exige decisao humana com evidencia; (2) interrupt de sessao V2 nativa (runtime API) NAO implementado - a prova do P24 e presenca, nao enforcement; (3) sem Job Objects (BLOCKER conhecido do P22) descendentes criados apos o snapshot CIM escapam da arvore.

criteria.criterion: repeated identical tool loops are interrupted within configured bounds.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase25.json#acceptance.repetition_suffix_semantics (3x identico => STALL_SUSPECTED; 5x => REPEATED_ACTION; ciclos A-B x3 => REPEATED_CYCLE; classificacao vence repeticao)
criteria.gap: Limites vem da policy de runtime_caps/bounded_execution e a execucao real depende de ativacao da flag watchdog (OFF) com evidencia no runtime exato.

criteria.criterion: a short repeated cycle without progress is interrupted.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase25.json#acceptance.bounded_iterator_spared / phase26.json#acceptance.bounded_iterator_spared (12 acoes distintas com marcador de progresso => NONE; filho sobrevive)
criteria.gap: Mesma pendencia de PAE-01: enforcement real exige flag watchdog OFF -> ativacao com evidencia; sem Job Objects a arvore tem cobertura por snapshot, nao garantida.

criteria.criterion: partial evidence survives interruption.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase26.json#acceptance.evidence_preserved (enforcement result carrega snapshot de classificacao + caminho do arquivo de telemetria; arquivo existe; conteudo nunca embutido)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase26.json#fix4 (gates de deadline por stop e pre-terminalizacao com evidencia PENDING parcial)
criteria.gap: Follow-ups de retencao multi-dia e lock cross-process ENTREGUES kernel-side em 2026-10-03 (RR-P25-FU1-WATCHDOG-TELEMETRY-HARDENING, FIX1..FIX8: gate cross-process com mutex nomeado bounded + tail-check anti-fragmento + retencao bounded com orcamento por entrada; suite 134/134; reviewer r4 + security r3 APPROVED). Restante: ativacao da flag watchdog (OFF/shadow) com evidencia = decisao humana no runtime exato.

criteria.criterion: deterministic stall retry with unchanged strategy/no new evidence is rejected.
criteria.gap: Refs de evidencia sao atestadas pelo Planner (existencia/frescor nao verificados pelo kernel); fingerprints sao lexicais (sinonimos reais => fingerprints distintos) - HOLD documentado.

criteria.criterion: second material failure requires Debugger.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase27.json#acceptance.c04_debugger_required (DEBUGGER_REQUIRED na 2a falha material; 3a sem novidade => EXHAUSTED)
criteria.gap: O kernel REGISTRA e EXIGE o Debugger; o dispatch real do Debugger continua sendo decisao do Planner (wiring comportamental e policy/prompt fora do slice - HOLD declarado em phase27.json#holds).

criteria.criterion: invalid third attempt becomes EXHAUSTED.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase26.json#acceptance.kernel_settlement_gate (auto-exhaustion tambem exige SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED antes de terminalizar)
criteria.gap: Typed waits estritos sao opt-in por task (require_typed_waits, default off); enforcement universal exigiria decisao de compatibilidade - HOLD declarado.

criteria.criterion: unknown PIDs are never killed automatically.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase26.json#acceptance.ownership_refused (executable divergente => REFUSED path-mismatch; start skew => REFUSED start-time-mismatch; proprio processo => REFUSED self; filhos intactos; PIDs desconhecidos nunca mortos)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase26.json#acceptance.no_identity_advisory (execucao sem identidade sob ENFORCE permanece advisory com WATCHDOG_NO_PROCESS_IDENTITY; sentinela intocada)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase23.json#holds (REUSE_NONE: sem reaproveitamento de servico; sem kill de PID desconhecido)
criteria.gap: Ator/fonte sao strings declaradas pelo chamador, sem autenticacao de processo - HOLD documentado e coberto por design (nenhum kill sem prova de ownership).

criteria.criterion: MCP waits are bounded and repeated outage opens a circuit.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase28.json#slice2_transport (budgets 30/60/120s; circuito por server/classe/turn; race + cleanup em finally; shadow default que nunca altera admissao)
criteria.gap: Enforcement em binario real V2 NAO validado (S2 e shadow por padrao; runMcpGuarded exige integracao explicita no host); V1 parity e observe-only.

criteria.criterion: new OpenCode root sessions default to Planner orchestration without user reminders.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase31.json#slice2_startup_wiring / #holds (scripts/runtime/SessionBootstrapContext.ps1: CLI hook-style fail-open TOTAL, parse-only, zero spawn/rede, telemetria metadata-only)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase31.json (builder S1: secoes project/runtime/capability_health/tasks/pending_waits/jev_status/aimemory_status, byte budget com sequencia unica de descarte)
criteria.gap: Componente ENTREGUE e INVOCAVEL, mas NADA registrado: auto-start do plugin, registro em hooks, AGENTS.md global e default_agent sao estado ativo do operador (HOLD declarado em phase31.json#holds). Sem isso nao ha default automatico em sessao root nova.

criteria.criterion: Task state survives root-session replacement.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase32.json#files (modelo de persistencia Task/Run/Seat/Session no kernel; secao bindings opcional backward-compatible com runs de provenance bounded)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase32.json#holds (kernel e a unica fonte de verdade; indice externo nunca e autoridade)
criteria.gap: Reconciler V2 nativo permanece HOLD (exige APIs exatas do runtime); integracao com plugin storage/runtime real = fatia 2; coordenacao cross-process de bindings = HOLD (single-writer in-process).

criteria.criterion: V2 Task↔Run↔Session bindings can be reconstructed after restart.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase32.json#files (bind/rebind/detach sob o lock CAS existente; single active_execution_owner por task; rebind somente mesma-sessao ou run detached; detach idempotente validando sessao registrada; CLI com 4 subcomandos, ambiguidade => exit 2 fail-closed)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase33.json#semantics (reconciler deterministico sobre os bindings de P32, caps 200/500 fail-closed, nunca executa probe/processo)
criteria.gap: Reconstrucao usa estados DECLARADOS pelo caller confiavel (probe real de sessao = HOLD) e reconciler V2 nativo = HOLD; coordenacao cross-process continua HOLD (single-writer in-process).

criteria.criterion: a completed child result is not lost because another child stalls.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase32.json#files (runs com provenance bounded; single active_execution_owner por task; binding start/resultado kernel-owned; transferencia em attach ativo proibida)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase26.json#acceptance.sibling_intact (interrupcao de um processo verificado nao toca irmaos)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase27.json#acceptance.c09_duplicate_active_work (DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_WORK com existing_task_id, nunca funde work units)
criteria.gap: Spawn real de workers e dispatch em sessao real seguem decisao do operador (P38-S2 e record-only por construcao: gate valida shape, nunca autenticidade de proveniencia; DONE/verified_pass permanece kernel-side).

criteria.criterion: Continuation Envelope resumes work without requiring the entire prior transcript.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase33.json#files (Continuation Envelope bounded 8KB: objective, intent, decisoes, evidencias, estrategias falhadas SEM transcripts, riscos, typed waits, next move; redator COMPARTILHADO em todos os campos string)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase33.json#semantics (envelope sem dump de transcript; reconciler nunca executa probe/processo)
criteria.gap: Registro kernel-side do resultado SESSION_LOST depende do caller (HOLD documentado: sem API de escrita de attempt result reutilizavel identificada sem editar o kernel); reconciler V2 nativo = HOLD.

criteria.criterion: V1 can continue the same Task through a fresh session even without native V2 graph features.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase33.json#files (V1 fresh-session sem fake resume; acoes recomendadas aplicaveis via CLI do P32 pelo caller)
criteria.gap: O CONTINUE e kernel-side e nao depende de grafo V2; o que falta e o wiring automatico em sessao V1 real (bootstrap P31-S2 sem registro em hooks = decisao do operador).

criteria.criterion: closing a session does not falsely mark the Task blocked or failed.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase33.json#semantics (SESSION_LOST: resultado tipado; registro kernel-side do resultado depende do caller; declaracao de missing + proof sem mutar task)
criteria.gap: O reconciler NAO marca a task; quem registra e o caller pelo caminho existente (HOLD documentado em phase33.json#holds). Probe real de sessao permanece HOLD.

criteria.criterion: Coder receives a stop condition and change scope.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase37.json#files (contract fields builder: MSC/NBW/RBC/ABE/stop-condition/NON_GOALS/PRESERVE/blast-radius, budget normalizado e sanitizado, caps de cardinalidade)

evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files#slice2 (contratos de worker com os 9 campos do contrato de delegacao derivados SOMENTE de plan+descriptor declarado; ausente => incomplete+missing_fields sem inventar)
criteria.gap: Edicao dos prompts canonicos source/agents e o wiring em dispatch real sao decisao do operador (HOLD declarado em phase37.json#holds e phase38.json#holds; o pipeline e record-only).

criteria.criterion: unrelated “bonus” changes are rejected or recorded outside the implementation.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase37.json#files (principios NBW e NON_GOALS no contract fields builder; caps de cardinalidade; budget normalizado)

evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files#slice2 (bundle de despacho deterministico: allowlist fechada de papeis, campos derivados somente do declarado, truncagem UTF-8 com escalada de reducao)
criteria.gap: Rejicao/registro efetivo depende do prompt canonico e do wiring de dispatch, ambos do operador; fast path de truncagem assume Unicode valido (residual LOW: surrogate orfao em string que ja cabe no cap).

criteria.criterion: materially exceeded change budget is visible to review.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase37.json#files (ChangeBudget com 4 combinacoes soft/hard x rationale, fronteiras 1x/2x, CHANGE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED; reviewer checklist ASSISTIDA deterministica em 4 categorias)
criteria.gap: A checklist e ASSISTIDA (deterministica, nao LLM) e depende de wiring no dispatch P38-S2, que e record-only ate ativacao do operador.

criteria.criterion: Tester consumes valid Coder evidence before deciding what to run.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase35.json#files (evidence store: identidade/provenance required, fingerprints SHA-256 com enumeracao bounded, invalidation_conditions allowlist+sanitize+cap ANTES da serializacao, validade por fingerprints/criteria/base-revision/ttl invariante, metricas hits/misses/lock-busy/errors/skipped-invalid)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase36.json#files (completion gate exige cobertura differential com conjunto COMPLETO de fingerprints com semantica P35; risk desconhecido => L3)

evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files#slice2 (prefill de evidencia somente de plan.reuse ok; persistencia via New-OrchestrationEvidenceRecord so com store_dir explicito e >=1 invalidation_condition)
criteria.gap: Integracao com o dispatch real do Planner e fatia 2/P38 e depende do operador; allowlist efetiva de verified_pass permanece a do kernel (verification-policy.json) - a lib apenas espelha o contrato.

criteria.criterion: equivalent valid checks are not repeated without rationale.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase35.json#files (fingerprints SHA-256 com framing len:valor; query ordenada desc com MaxResults e sem raw content; metricas de hits/misses)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase36.json#files (differential coverage exigindo conjunto completo de fingerprints; base revision + ttl, default 30d/7d fail-closed)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files (loop deterministico com estagio Reuse antes de dispatch)
criteria.gap: Store e file-based no evidence dir do caller, sem daemon/database; uso no fluxo real depende do wiring P38-S2 (operador). TTL de expiracao e fail-closed por design.

criteria.criterion: Reviewer receives the exact candidate/bundle and applicable rules.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase36.json#files (reviewer bundle deterministico; security coverage ledger confirmed/needs-validation com writer que rejeita confirmed incompleto)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files#slice2 (bundle de despacho com determinismo byte-identico, gate_status em vocabulario fechado sem eco de entrada)
criteria.gap: O gate valida SHAPE e consistencia interna, NAO autenticidade de proveniencia: o bundle nunca e autoridade independente e DONE/verified_pass permanece kernel-side (HOLD declarado em phase38.json#holds).

criteria.criterion: low-risk work is not forced through the full L3 pipeline.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase36.json#files (classificacao L0-L3 consumindo validation-policy.json como autoridade; completion gate com effective_level = max(declarado, reclassificado, minimum_by_risk))
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files (fallback conservador C/L2 no loop deterministico; Jev nao-autoritativo; budget record-only)
criteria.gap: Wiring real no fluxo de dispatch/completion = fatia 2/P38 e depende do operador; o gate de completion do P38-S2 e fail-closed e nunca mais permissivo que o P36.

criteria.criterion: high-risk work cannot silently downgrade required independent validation.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase36.json#files (policy fail-closed: invalida => L3; hard triggers incontornaveis varrendo domain/operation/summary; minimum_by_risk; bypass L1+critical e L2+auth testados)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase36.json#holds (allowlist de verified_pass permanece a do kernel)
criteria.gap: Nenhuma: o rebaixamento e barrado no kernel e no gate de completion; permanece o wiring de operador para o fluxo real, sem folga de autoridade.

criteria.criterion: fan-out cannot consume reserved validation/review budget.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files (parallel_ok por ownership/separabilidade - nunca so por capacidade)

evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files#slice2 (no-widen: budget nao reservado => rota minima com withheld_roles; workers declarado vazio => 0 contratos; cap de workers com contador de consumo independente; enumerable sem contagem consome no maximo cap+1)
criteria.gap: Enumerable limita QUANTIDADE consumida, nao duracao de cada operacao (nao e sandbox - HOLD documentado); spawn real de workers e ativacao operacional do despacho = decisao do operador.

criteria.criterion: Jev is available persistently but is not called for every task.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase29.json#semantics (trigger policy deterministica pura; tarefa trivial NUNCA consulta; tool set fechado; budget 30s, probe 10s, circuito 2/300s)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase29.json#files (bounded invoke reusando o envelope P28, classe advisory, seam sintetica, zero rede)
criteria.gap: Transporte real Jev (rede) NAO ativado (seam sintetica; zero primitivas de rede no lib); flag jev_advisory {enabled:false, shadow:true} OFF; integracao no fluxo do Planner = P31-S2/P38-S2 e ativacao do operador.

criteria.criterion: Jev cannot grant permission, widen scope or write DONE.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase29.json#semantics (authority guard sempre-nega: kernel deny vence Jev allow; verifier fail vence Jev complete)
criteria.gap: TurnId e declarado pelo chamador sem autenticacao de identidade (disponibilidade atacavel documentada; OPEN nunca libera REQUIRED) - HOLD herdado do P28.

criteria.criterion: Jev unavailable falls back without infinite retry.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase29.json#semantics (criticality optional: JEV_UNAVAILABLE => fallback deterministico; circuito 2 falhas/300s de cooldown)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase28.json#acceptance.ac06_optional_fallback + #acceptance.ac07_required_blocker (required => MCP_REQUIRED_BLOCKED fail-closed em todos os ramos)
criteria.gap: O fallback e provado contra seam sintetica; transporte real nao ativado. Locks in-process (coordenacao cross-process = follow-up) e ocupacao por abandono nao-reclaimable limitada por recusa (cap 8).

criteria.criterion: capability doctor reports health/fallback status without granting authority.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase39.json#files (doctor read-only com probes sinteticos injetaveis; fallback map validando destino existente/suportado; risk_class execution/authority sem health => typed blocker, nunca fallback silencioso; saida sanitizada/bounded/determinista)
evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase39.json#files (descriptor com schema validation tipada; platform_support booleano ESTRITO apos bug [bool]"false")
criteria.gap: Probes REAIS de health sao HOLD (fatia de transporte); nesta fatia o budget e metadado honesto e o timeout real e HOLD explicito do transporte. Instalacao automatica de capabilities fora de escopo (plan 16.6).

criteria.criterion: optional semantic code discovery falls back when unsupported/unhealthy.
evidence: evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase39.json#files (semantic discovery OPTIONAL com Windows-unsupported estruturado e routing_hint; fallback orders em source/registry/capability-doctor-policy.json)
criteria.gap: jevgrep real (binario real) permanece HOLD ate instalado/suportado comprovado - o caminho de fallback e provado, a ferramenta real nao.

criteria.criterion: V2 session hierarchy/provenance is recorded where exact-runtime support is proven.

evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase40.json#slice2_supersession (gating fail-closed: enabled SO com evidencia exact-binary-live valida - feature/pin 2.0.18/scenario exact-match + SHA-256; timestamp RFC3339 com offset obrigatorio; registry ausente/corrompido/escalar => NOT_PROVEN; lib read-only nunca escreve evidencia)

Ativar exige evidencia exact-binary-live no binario 2.0.18 no ambiente do operador (P42). O SHA-256 comprova INTEGRIDADE do conteudo, nao autenticidade do produtor - ownership confiavel do evidence registry e do operador.

evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase38.json#files#slice2 (no-widen: budget nao reservado => rota minima com withheld_roles)

criteria.criterion: background child completion can be reconciled after parent/runtime restart.

evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/phase32.json#files (reattach resolvendo attached->detached; CLI detach/rebind/detach com 4 subcomandos)

criteria.criterion: experimental event-log/snapshot features are auxiliary, not authoritative.

criteria.gap: As features continuam hold-unproven (exigem prova no binario 2.0.18) e o wiring de chamada advisory do revisor de supersessao permanece do operador/kernel (fora de escopo). A propriedade AUXILIAR esta garantida por construcao: authority_impact nunca widening.

release_gate_note.statement: PAE-39 e PAE-31 sao BLOCKED-OPERATOR-EVIDENCE; PAE-10 e ACTIVATION-PENDING; e as 36 conclusoes kernel-side dependem de ativacoes que hoje estao todas OFF. O release gate do operador e, portanto: (1) lane V2 Windows real no binario exato 2.0.18 cobrindo watchdog e cross-session (PAE-39; 23 cenarios blocked no manifest do P42); (2) evidencia exact-binary-live para as 8 features de source/registry/v2-native-capabilities.json (PAE-31); (3) ativacoes de flag com evidencia - bounded_execution, watchdog, task_kernel, jev_advisory, runtime_grant_enforcement, runtime_caps - todas OFF hoje; (4) deploy do VPS AI Memory + re-preflight de porta e fechamento dos HOLDs de REUSE; (5) probes reais de health/transporte e jevgrep real; (6) wirings de chamador em producao: P31-S2 (hooks/AGENTS.md global/default_agent), P38-S2 (dispatch), P40-S2 (append/enable), P41-S2 (telemetria).
release_gate_note.no_fake_close: SEM FAKE-CLOSE: program_concluded permanece false em program-status.json e nenhum item deste gate pode ser marcado fechado por inferencia, por suite sintetica ou por doc. O commit de closure sugerido pelo plan so acontece com evidencia real do operador.
release_gate_note.no_new_flags: Nenhuma flag de rollout nova ALEM de jev_advisory e criada por este programa. Das 11 flags sugeridas no SPEC ADDENDUM §26, apenas 2 existem no registry: watchdog (pre-existente do V3) e jev_advisory (P29, sancao explicita do plan §6.1, {enabled:false, shadow:true}). As 9 demais - loop_guard, mcp_safety, persistent_bootstrap, cross_session_binding, execution_mode_router, evidence_reuse, adaptive_validation, capability_doctor, orchestration_evolution - NAO foram criadas, por design conservador: dependem de primitivas de runtime ainda em HOLD, e criar flag para primitiva inexistente seria um gate vazio. O rollout usa exclusivamente as flags EXISTENTES, todas OFF/shadow.
